$comment: Corresponding-source copies: operator task 26 (PROGRESS.md) and npm run build:offline -- --sources <folder> (unresolved 211).
Read by scripts/release/fetch-sources.ps1 (Windows PowerShell 5.1), scripts/lib/offline-sources.mjs and tests/unit/release/. Guide: scripts/release/README.md.

sha256/sha512/md5 = official value (hashSource says where it comes from). An item with no official value must name its git commit (commit): fetch-sources.ps1 and scripts/lib/offline-sources.mjs check that the GitHub archive carries that commit (git archive pax header comment=) and can be read to its end, then record its SHA-256 (RECORD); pin that value in sha256 afterwards (README section 3). build:offline --sources and release-notes.mjs refuse a list with unpinned items.

site = the versions this list belongs to. When the site ships another Pyodide, OpenCV wheel or Pagefind, npm test fails until this list is updated (Pagefind is checked too: its search wasm needs a source group only while it contains a GPL crate).

2026-11-03 (site 1.9.1, DECISIONS C241): Pagefind 1.6.0 replaced the GPL-3.0-only crate pagefind_microjson with hifijson 0.5.0 (MIT), so the 'gpl-pagefind' group (Pagefind v1.5.2 source + 21 crates) was removed from this list. Those 22 files stay in the release license-sources-2026-09 for people who received site versions 1.0.0-1.9.0 (written offer in public/licenses/pagefind-wasm-3rd-party.txt); the same release still holds the 12 files of the 'lgpl-ffmpeg' group listed here.

groups.title: FFmpeg 4.4.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later) statically linked into the OpenCV wheel
groups.titleKo: OpenCV 휠 안의 FFmpeg 4.4.1(GNU LGPL 2.1 이상)
groups.why: LGPL-2.1 section 6: whoever receives cv2.so must be able to get the source of FFmpeg (with any changes - there are none) and of the work that uses it, with the scripts that build them, so that they can change FFmpeg and relink cv2.so.
groups.whyKo: LGPL-2.1 6조: cv2.so를 받은 사람이 FFmpeg 소스(고친 곳 — 여기서는 없음)와 FFmpeg를 쓰는 저작물의 소스·빌드 방법을 받아, FFmpeg를 고쳐 cv2.so를 다시 연결할 수 있어야 해요.
groups.tools: Emscripten 5.0.3 (its ports zlib 1.3.1, libjpeg 9f and libpng 1.6.55 are compiled into cv2.so, so their sources are in this list), the Pyodide cross-build environment 314.0.6, and the CMake and Python build tools named in the recipes
groups.toolsKo: Emscripten 5.0.3(그 포트 zlib 1.3.1·libjpeg 9f·libpng 1.6.55는 cv2.so에 함께 들어가서 소스를 이 목록에 넣었어요), Pyodide 교차 빌드 환경 314.0.6, 레시피에 적힌 CMake·파이썬 빌드 도구
